name: Manage Comment Own Content
description: Lets users manage (approve/update/delete/view unpublished) comments on content THEY own — correctly ownership-scoped.
project_description:
Allows users to manage comments (per comment type) on their own content.

 Features 

 
 New permissions:
 
 {comment_type} update comments on own content
 {comment_type} delete comments on own content
 {comment_type} view unpublished comments on own content
 view overview of comments on own content
 
 A comment formatter which supports the 'view unpublished comments on own content' permission
 A view, disabled by default, on user/{uid}/comments only listing the comments on the content the user has created
